Class EfsDispatcherThreadAbstract.ThreadBuilder<A extends EfsDispatcherThreadAbstract, B extends EfsDispatcherThreadAbstract.ThreadBuilder<A,?>>

java.lang.Object
org.efs.dispatcher.EfsDispatcherThreadAbstract.ThreadBuilder<A,B>
Type Parameters:
A - builder this dispatcher thread instance.
B - thread builder type.
Enclosing class:
EfsDispatcherThreadAbstract
protected abstract static class EfsDispatcherThreadAbstract.ThreadBuilder<A extends EfsDispatcherThreadAbstract, B extends EfsDispatcherThreadAbstract.ThreadBuilder<A,?>> extends Object
Base builder for concrete dispatcher-thread implementations.

This builder captures the configuration shared by all dispatcher-thread types, including the thread name, execution model, priority, optional affinity, and maximum events per agent dispatch. Concrete subclasses provide the specific thread implementation class and return their own builder type from self() and buildImpl().

Charles W. Rapp

    • validate

      protected net.sf.eBus.util.Validator validate(net.sf.eBus.util.Validator problems)
      Validates the builder settings required to construct a dispatcher thread. Requires thread name and thread type to be set.

      Concrete subclasses may extend this method to add additional validation rules beyond the base thread name and thread type checks. Any validation failures are recorded in the supplied Validator and raised by build() before the thread is created.

      Parameters:
      problems - store invalid builder settings into this list.
      Returns:
      problems containing any validation failures.
